topic: get a smooth roller finish without stipple marks
core_question: How do you get a smooth, streak-free finish when painting a wall instead of visible roller texture? (secondary: How do you stop a table from rocking because one leg is shorter than the others?)
answer_summary: Choose a roller nap suited to the wall texture and paint type, load it evenly, and finish each section with light, even back-rolling strokes in one direction.; after the topic shift: Find the short leg, then either turn its adjustable leveler foot, glue on a small shim/furniture leg cap, or sand down the other legs so all legs sit flush.
persona: impatient and curt; writing terse one-liners
